title: Bent direct product
statement: Given real-valued functions $f$ and $g$ on Boolean cubes of dimensions $n$ and $m$, respectively, define their direct product on the cube of dimension $n+m$ by splitting each input into its first $n$ and last $m$ coordinates and multiplying the corresponding function values.
